spans.s: Śaiśava, pl. (ºāh), a people. § 295 (Dyūtap.): II, 52, 1874 (among the peoples who brought tribute to Yudhishṭhira).

Śaiśira, a mountain (= Himavat, PCR.). § 442 (Nivātakavacay.): III, 167, 11949.--§ 443 (do.): III, 168, 11999 (ºsya gireḥ pāde), 12026.--§ 603 (Nārāyaṇāstramokshap.): VII, 199, 9242 (samarthau parvatasyāpi Śºsya nipātane, says Bhīma about his arms).--§ 714 (Śukakṛtya): XII, 328, 12313.
Śaiśupāli (“son of Śiśupāla”) = Dhṛshṭaketu: III, 15252 (so B.; C. has Śaiśupālaṃ, vanquished by Karṇa on his digvijaya); V, 2011, 4221; VII, 1511, 5039, 5045.
Saisikata, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VII, 9, 365 (only C., B. has Saisiridhrāḥ).
